utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still lining up the Saturday porch schedule, so if you can tell me what time works for you, I’ll fit you in and keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I can help at the front porch on Saturday, and I’m free after 10 if that works for the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch — I’m glad to help if I can. Just remind me what time you need me there, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — I really appreciate it. Can you be there around 10 a.m. on Saturday at the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Uli — I’m counting on you Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll be there Saturday at 9 on the front porch. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I’m setting up the repair drive this Saturday on my front porch, and I could use a few helping hands. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’m in for Saturday at your front porch for the repair drive. I’ll check the time and get back to you so we can line up the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be fantastic, Tess — thank you. I’ll get everything ready on the porch and let you know what time to come by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Sam — just send me the time and I’ll be there. I’ll see if I can round up a couple more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do Saturday morning at the front porch, around 9. Just let me know what to handle when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli. Around 9 on Saturday morning at the front porch works for me, and I’ll have something for you to handle when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Vik. I’ll count on you Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check the time and let you know so we can line up the helpers for Saturday at the front porch.
